headline: Mumsnet denies using AI to write posts after an AI prompt for a reply surfaced on its message board.
score_reason: Pool 2 kept: read in full; a real dispute about the site's own explanation, with a small reach.
importance_line: It matters most to Mumsnet's members, who want to know whether the advice they read is written by people, and the cause of the prompt is not settled because users reject the site's explanations.
summary: The Guardian reports that Mumsnet denied using AI to write posts after a detailed prompt for an AI-written 'am I being unreasonable' reply appeared on its forum, and users rejected its explanations. Justine Roberts, founder of Mumsnet, confirmed the prompt came from the site's system, which sends drafts to OpenAI to suggest thread titles, called it an apparent error on OpenAI's side, and said: “We don’t use AI to write threads or replies on Mumsnet.”
notes: Full text read (fulltext/C16-07.txt, 4007 chars). Named person given position in the same sentence. No google link; publisher link used.
